items.title: Route story scope git diffs through the authoritative story worktree cwd
items.context: Use resolveGitCwd for scope_contract_check and runScopeTransitionGate while preserving metadataRoot for story metadata and material hash exclusion.

happy.desc: A story with a clean authoritative worktree passes scope_contract_check even when metadataRoot has unrelated dirty files.

edge.desc: story_advance REVIEW scope rows show only the story-owned changed files from the worktree, not metadataRoot dirt.

adversarial.desc: Do not acknowledge or whitelist unrelated metadataRoot paths; the regression must fail if the gate reads the wrong cwd again.

verificationEvidence.note: Regression fixture creates unrelated metadataRoot dirt while the authoritative story worktree only changes an allowed file; direct scope_contract_check passes and changedFiles contains only src/allowed.ts.
The same regression fixture calls runScopeTransitionGate from metadataRoot and asserts the lifecycle output reports Scope gate: pass without the metadataRoot dirty path.
The test fails if the gate reads metadataRoot again because src/root-dirt.ts would appear as an out-of-scope changed file; no acknowledgement or whitelist is used for that root dirt.

items.title: Apply Proofbound CLI patch-version discipline for this runtime behavior change
items.context: If this Story adopts the hotfix, bump the Proofbound CLI patch version and verify build/version output through the normal lifecycle.

happy.desc: npm --prefix packages/main run build succeeds and lattice --version reports the bumped patch version.

edge.desc: The version bump is scoped to Proofbound CLI package and brand surfaces, not downstream project Ranking versions.

adversarial.desc: This Story must not claim DONE until REVIEW, TEST, summary, delivery, and done_prepare gates pass.

verificationEvidence.command: npm --prefix packages/main run build; node packages/main/dist/cli.js --version; lattice --version
verificationEvidence.note: Build succeeded, node packages/main/dist/cli.js --version printed Proofbound CLI 0.3.169, and lattice --version also printed Proofbound CLI 0.3.169.

verificationEvidence.command: rg -n "0\.3\.168|0\.3\.169" package.json packages/main/package.json package-lock.json packages/main/package-lock.json packages/main/src/core/lattice-brand.ts
verificationEvidence.note: Only Proofbound CLI version surfaces were bumped to 0.3.169: root/package manifests, both package locks, and LATTICE_CLI_VERSION. No downstream project Ranking/package version files were touched.
This evidence records build/version proof only; the story remains in DEV until checklist, REVIEW, TEST, summary, delivery, done_prepare, and DONE gates pass.
